newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's NYBB upgrades Zalakeramia to buy.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's NYBB upgrades Zalakeramia to buy.

text.p: Hungarian securities house New York Broker Budapest on Tuesday upgraded Zalakeramia Rt to buy from sell, saying the tilemaker had promising opportunities in central Europe.
Analyst Gabriella Bor revised the ratings for both short and long term.
"There are still market opportunities in Slovakia, Ukraine, Poland and Russia," Bor said in a research note.
The company reported a significant increase in domestic sales for the first quarter of the year and a recovery in the construction sector would propel further growth, Bor said.

New York Broker expects the price of Zalakeramia to rise to 8,000 forints soon, it said, adding that according to the technical analysis, the price was likely to rise to between 11,500 and 13,000 by the end of 1997.
